# 3 bed semi-detached house for sale

> DNG McCormack Properties are delighted to present this exceptional 3-bedroom semi- detached residence to the market. Constructed in 2022 and boasting an impressive A-rated BER, this spacious and contemporary family home offers stylish, energy-efficient living in the heart of Allenwood Village.

- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Plocha: 106 m²
- Energetická náročnost: A2
- Lokalita: 91 Grand Canal Wood, Allenwood
- Cena: 395 000 €
